baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command at word 1 governs the comprehensive quantifier at word 4 and a named destination.
baseline_models.mechanism: Casting supplies directed transfer, while comprehensive totality distributes that transfer across every member of the qualified class.

activation_trace.role: Casting or throwing supplies the directed transfer into the named destination.
Comprehensive totality makes the command distributive across the whole qualifying class.

changed_reading.before: A generic order to throw disbelievers into Hell.
changed_reading.after: A destination-directed transfer applied without omission to each person meeting the paired qualification.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacent intensive qualifier at word 5 and directional qualifier at word 6 define the object of the command.
baseline_models.mechanism: Repeated or entrenched covering of truth is joined to active deviation and opposition; the two qualifiers form an epistemic-volitional mechanism rather than redundant abuse.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the basic concealment action intensified by the focus form.
Blocking acknowledged truth specifies what the covering does in the judgment category.
Deviation from straightness with resistance turns concealment into active opposition.
Sideward separation gives the opposition a spatial and directional profile.

changed_reading.before: Two emphatic labels for a generically bad unbeliever.
changed_reading.after: A person who repeatedly covers truth and makes that covering operative by turning aside and resisting it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command root at word 1 contains casting, meeting, and what a person meets of harm.
baseline_models.mechanism: The physical cast can simultaneously be heard as compelling the condemned to meet the adverse consequence formerly kept at a distance.

activation_trace.role: Meeting between opposed sides opens an encounter value within the casting root.
What one meets of harm supplies the consequence encountered at the destination.

changed_reading.before: Casting is only expulsion from one place.
changed_reading.after: Casting is also forced arrival at, and encounter with, the consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Every self arrives under a driving and witnessing pair, then a companion presents what is ready; the dual casting command becomes the handoff from individualized conveyance and evidence to execution.

activation_trace.role: The focus cast performs the terminal transfer supplied by the preceding roles.
Every self is individually included, matching the focus command's comprehensive scope.
Driving and expulsion supply compelled movement toward the judicial scene.
Knowledge-based testimony supplies an evidentiary function beside compelled movement.
The attached companion carries the paired-person architecture into the moment before command.
Present readiness marks the case or person as prepared for immediate transfer.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from each self with two functions, through a companion's ready presentation, directly to a dual imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies individualized arrival, paired functions, companionship, readiness, and a dual command; I infer a procedural handoff, while the exact identity of the command's two addressees remains open.

changed_reading.before: The command orders an undifferentiated mass expulsion.
changed_reading.after: Each escorted and witnessed case is handed into the execution stage, without requiring a fixed identification of the two executors.

context_deltas.mechanism: Heedlessness is followed by removal of a covering and penetrating sight; this literal uncovering activates the focus concealer as a culpable pattern that judgment exposes rather than mere lack of information.

activation_trace.role: Covering is the focus action reversed by the preceding unveiling.
Concealment of truth gives the uncovered object its epistemic and judicial force.
Being outside alert awareness supplies the prior obscured condition.
Lifting a cover explicitly reverses the focus root's covering image.
The concealing cover supplies the material object removed before judgment.
Sharp penetration makes the post-unveiling sight resistant to renewed concealment.

structural_cues: Cover, its removal, and sharpened sight occur two ayat before the focus designation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heedlessness, cover-removal, sharp sight, and a focus covering lexeme; I infer that unveiling retrospectively exposes the culpable concealment, while an eschatological-only unveiling remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The focus qualifier may name simple ignorance or unbelief without a material mechanism.
changed_reading.after: It names entrenched truth-covering whose object is forcibly uncovered and can no longer remain hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus image of sideward deviation expands into a motion sequence: swerving from the truth-bearing event, being driven, crossing a limit, and remaining far from the intended course; casting fixes the destination of a trajectory defined by attempted lateral escape.

activation_trace.role: Sideward separation anchors the directional reading in the focus qualifier.
Casting supplies the externally imposed terminal vector.
Turning away from the path supplies the earlier evasive motion.
Driving replaces self-directed evasion with compelled motion.
Crossing the limit makes the deviation behavioral rather than merely attitudinal.
Loss of the intended path supplies the trajectory's extended condition.

structural_cues: Directional vocabulary brackets the focus: evasion and driving precede it; limit-crossing and far straying follow it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies four directional images and the focus cast; I connect them as one trajectory ending in forced routing, while they may alternatively be independent descriptions of wrongdoing and escort.

changed_reading.before: The focus qualifier describes a static personality trait of stubbornness.
changed_reading.after: It describes repeated sideward evasion and boundary-crossing that ends when external driving and casting fix the destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Readiness before the command and the subsequent bar on dispute, prior advancement of warning, non-substitution of the word, and denial of wrongful placement frame casting as implementation of a settled case rather than an impulsive sentence.

activation_trace.role: The directed cast is the concrete implementation whose procedural status is changed by context.
Present readiness places the case at an execution-ready stage.
Adversarial dispute supplies the proceeding that is explicitly closed.
Advancing beforehand supplies prior notice rather than a surprise command.
Substitution is negated, making the operative word non-replaceable at execution.
Wrong emplacement supplies the negated contrast to casting into the specified destination.

structural_cues: A ready presentation precedes the command; procedural closure and non-alteration immediately follow it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies readiness, closed dispute, prior warning, non-substitution, and denied wrong placement; I infer an execution-stage procedure, while the assertions may also function as sovereign declarations rather than procedural steps.

changed_reading.before: The imperative sounds like a sudden punitive outburst.
changed_reading.after: It is the terminal, non-substitutable implementation of a case already presented and warned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later exchange about equal-to-vessel fullness and a request for increase separates the focus quantifier's legal scope from the destination's capacity: every qualifying offender can be cast without implying that this batch exhausts the receiver.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive totality quantifies the qualifying persons.
Casting supplies successive entries into the receiver.
Fullness equal to a vessel introduces capacity as a distinct question.
Seeking increase keeps the receiver open to further intake.

structural_cues: The focus says every qualifying person; 50:30 separately asks whether Hell is full and voices more.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal scope and a later capacity exchange; I infer a scope-capacity distinction, while the exchange may alternatively be rhetorical intensification rather than intake logic.

changed_reading.before: Every is heard as a finite batch whose casting fills Hell to completion.
changed_reading.after: Every ranges over each qualifying offender, while the destination remains capable of successive additions.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links human judgment to mountain emplacement; it remains valid because 50:7 repeats the focus root with an in-destination construction and stable placement, but downstream prose should present only a spatial-material echo, never a moral equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The casting root at word 1 can denote putting something into a destination, not only discarding it.

activation_trace.role: The focus cast anchors destination-directed emplacement.
Earlier casting puts stabilizing entities into the earth, activating placement rather than casual disposal.
Stability is the result of the earlier emplacement, supplying the polarity with punitive fixation.
The repeated individual cast confirms emplacement into the severe punitive destination.

changed_reading.before: The verb pictures only a violent toss.
changed_reading.after: It may also picture irreversible emplacement into an assigned realm, darkly echoing an earlier ordering placement with opposite value.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the agricultural branch could be mistaken for lexical substitution; it remains anchored in an attested focus branch activated by contextual growth, grain, harvest, and emergence, but downstream prose must call it an image or counter-sowing and must not translate the focus qualifier as farmer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The intensive concealer at word 5 has a seed-covering branch, beside the command to deposit its bearer into a destination.

activation_trace.role: Covering seed activates an agricultural image without replacing the focus's judgment sense.
Depositing the concealer supplies the grim counter-sowing action.
Cultivation and caused growth establish the productive sowing frame.
The seed that sprouts supplies the covered unit from which growth proceeds.
Cutting the crop supplies the harvest endpoint of the agricultural cycle.
Emergence from within connects the growth cycle to resurrection before the punitive deposit.

changed_reading.before: The focus qualifier is heard only as a doctrinal category.
changed_reading.after: The intensive concealer momentarily carries a seed-covering image: after resurrection's emergence, the coverer is himself deposited into a punitive counter-harvest.

strongest_changes: The dual imperative became an individualized handoff from escort and testimony to execution.
Cover-removal and sharp sight recast the focus concealer as exposed, culpable concealment rather than mere ignorance.
The obstinate qualifier became a directional trajectory of evasion, boundary-crossing, and eventual forced routing.
The comprehensive quantifier was separated from Hell's capacity: it scopes offenders rather than asserting completed fullness.
summary.what_was_special: The same focus roots sustained legal, directional, and material models at once: casting became transfer, encounter, and emplacement, while concealment admitted a tightly contained counter-sowing image.
remaining_uncertainties: The context does not uniquely identify the two addressees of the dual imperative.
The procedural and motion-chain arrows are reader reconstructions rather than explicit causal syntax.
The mountain-emplacement and agricultural echoes should remain exploratory imagery.
